channel.title: Moneat Blog
channel.description: Engineering deep-dives, observability best practices, and product updates from the Moneat team.

item.title: Sentry vs Datadog vs Moneat: The 2026 Error Monitoring Comparison
item.description: An honest feature and pricing comparison of Sentry, Datadog, and Moneat for error monitoring, session replays, logs, and more.
item.author: Adrian Elder

item.title: We Replaced Sentry in 10 Minutes — Here's How (Drop-In Migration Guide)
item.description: A step-by-step guide to migrating from Sentry to Moneat. One line of code per service, no re-instrumentation, no new SDKs.
item.author: Adrian Elder

item.title: All-in-One Observability: Errors, Replays, Logs, Uptime & Analytics in a Single Platform
item.description: The average engineering team pays for 4–6 monitoring tools. Here's why a unified observability platform saves money, reduces debugging time, and eliminates cognitive fragmentation.
item.author: Adrian Elder

item.title: How to Self-Host Your Observability Stack (and Why You Should)
item.description: Self-hosting observability used to mean significant complexity. In 2026, a Docker Compose deploy gives you data ownership, cost control, and feature completeness.
item.author: Adrian Elder

item.title: The True Cost of Datadog: How Observability Billing Surprises Kill Budgets
item.description: A breakdown of how Datadog's per-product, per-host, per-volume pricing model creates unpredictable bills — and what teams are doing instead.
item.author: Adrian Elder
